analysis_notes.summary: Jahmyr Gibbs' 5-game rollover touchdown streak ended in Week 7 after he voluntarily went down at the 2-yard line to seal a team victory.

analysis_notes.quote: He voluntarily went down at the two yard line to get the team the win.

analysis_notes.summary: The trade and removal of interior defensive tackles drastically weakens Tennessee's run defense against opposing starting running backs.
